name: Apps
intro: Apps is the home screen of SmartVideo, a searchable grid of every creative tool. Pick the one you need, and it opens straight away.

features.search-apps: Type in the search box to filter the cards by name and description. Sections with no matches disappear, so you can find a tool like upscale in seconds.
features.section-groups: Tools are grouped into Image apps, Video apps, Agents apps and My Work. Start from the kind of output you want, and pick the section that fits.
features.recently-used: After you open a tool from this page, it appears as a chip in the Recently Used row. That gives you a one click way back to the tools you use most.

outro: That's the Apps hub. Search or browse, open a card, and you're in the studio you need.
